title: Heparin vs Placebo for Cardiac Catheterization
official: A Randomized Trial of Heparin vs Placebo in Patients Undergoing Cardiac Catheterization Via the Trans-radial Approach
summary: Patients undergoing cardiac catheterization will be randomized to 3 groups: no anticoagulant, low dose anticoagulant and high dose anticoagulant.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnostic cardiac catheterization; Small size sheath; patency of the ulno-palmar circulation

Exclusion Criteria:

abnormal ulno-palmar circulation; Prior radial artery thrombosis; Prior surgery close to the access site; Emergent cardiac catheterization; History of HIT or allergy to heparin; Patients requiring anticoagulation
sponsor: London Health Sciences Centre Research Institute OR Lawson Research Institute of St. Joseph's
